title: The Dead Sea
text: The Dead Sea is a salt lake bordered by Jordan to the east and Israel and the West Bank to the west. It lies in the Jordan Rift Valley and its surface and shores are approximately 430 meters below sea level, making it Earth's lowest elevation on land. The Dead Sea is about 9.6 times saltier than the ocean, with a salinity of approximately 34%. This extreme salinity means no multicellular organisms can survive in it, hence its name. The high salt concentration allows bathers to float effortlessly. The Dead Sea has been shrinking due to water diversion from its main tributary, the Jordan River, losing about one meter of water level per year.
